"""Large bounded request: 8192 distinct prefixes, many puts/queries, 3 saves, 16 loads."""
import json, random, sys, os, time, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from ref import Fib, Image, Bad

def build(seed, npref=8192, nput=40000, nq=4000):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    prefixes = set()
    ops = []
    # worst case-ish: deep chains of 11 nodes with 3 prefixes each
    while len(prefixes) < npref:
        v = rng.getrandbits(124)
        base = '%032x' % (v << 4)
        for ln, delta in ((124, 0), (125, 1), (126, 2)):
            vv = (v << 4) | (delta & 0xF) if False else (v << 4)
            p = '%032x' % (((v << 4) | (delta & 0xF)) & ((1 << 128) - 1))
            prefixes.add((p, ln))
        if len(prefixes) >= npref - 1:
            break
    prefixes = list(prefixes)[:npref]
    hops = {}
    for i, (p, ln) in enumerate(prefixes):
        h = rng.randint(0, 4194302)
        hops[(p, ln)] = h
        ops.append(['put', p, ln, h])
    # queries: exact addresses and neighbours
    addrs = []
    for (p, ln) in rng.sample(prefixes, min(2000, len(prefixes))):
        addrs.append(p)
        v = int(p, 16)
        addrs.append('%032x' % (v | (1 << rng.randrange(128 - ln, 128)) if ln else v))
    addrs += ['%032x' % rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(1000)]
    # interleave saves/loads
    nsave = 0
    nload = 0
    out = []
    chunk = max(1, len(ops) // 3)
    for i, op in enumerate(ops):
        out.append(op)
        if i and i % chunk == 0 and nsave < 3:
            out.append(['save']); nsave += 1
        if i and i % (chunk // 2 or 1) == 0 and nsave and nload < 16:
            out.append(['load_saved', rng.randrange(nsave)]); nload += 1
    while nsave < 3:
        out.append(['save']); nsave += 1
    while nload < 16:
        out.append(['load_saved', rng.randrange(nsave)]); nload += 1
    half = len(addrs) // 2
    out.append(['query', addrs[:half]])
    out.append(['image_query', addrs[half:]])
    return {"cases": [{"ops": out}]}

def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1
    req = build(seed)
    body = json.dumps(req, separators=(',', ':'))
    print('request bytes', len(body))
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'run.py'], input=body.encode(), cwd='/workspace',
                       capture_output=True, timeout=600)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    print('elapsed %.2fs rc=%d' % (dt, p.returncode))
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print(p.stderr.decode()[:2000]); raise SystemExit(1)
    resp = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    res = resp['results'][0]
    print('answers', len(res['answers']), 'snaps', len(res['snapshots']), 'loads', res['loads'])
    # verify
    fib = Fib()
    exp = []
    si = 0; li = 0; loaded = None
    snaps = res['snapshots']
    for op in req['cases'][0]['ops']:
        if op[0] == 'put': fib.put(op[1], op[2], op[3])
        elif op[0] == 'query':
            for a in op[1]: exp.append(fib.lpm(a))
        elif op[0] == 'image_query':
            for a in op[1]: exp.append(loaded.lookup(a) if loaded else None)
        elif op[0] == 'save': si += 1
        elif op[0] == 'load_saved': loaded = Image(snaps[op[1]]); li += 1
    bad = [(i, a, b) for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(exp, res['answers'])) if a != b]
    print('mismatches', len(bad), bad[:5])
    for img in snaps:
        Image(img)
    print('cells', snaps[0]['cells'], 'rows', sum(len(b) for b in snaps[0]['banks']))
    if bad: raise SystemExit(1)
    print('BIGTEST PASS')

main()
